revenue_growth.source: Assumption: FY2025 growth was 10.5% (23,769 vs 21,505); fade gradually toward ~7% as the base scales and AI competition matures.

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: FY2025 GAAP EBIT margin 36.6% (8,706/23,769), up from 31.3% in FY2024; hold roughly flat at 37%.

tax_rate.source: Assumption: FY2025 effective rate ~18% (pretax 8,734 vs net income 7,130, accession 0000796343-26-000003); 17% used for modest benefits.

wacc.source: Assumption: CAPM cost of equity = 10Y UST 4.86% (Treasury, 2026-11-06) + assumed beta 1.05 x Damodaran US ERP 4.46% (2026-02-16) = ~9.5%; debt is small (6,210 vs equity value far larger), so WACC ~ cost of equity. Beta is my assumption, not looked up.

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: below the 4.86% risk-free rate and near long-run nominal GDP growth.

net_debt.source: financial_statements derived net_debt: debt 6,210 - cash 5,431 - short-term investments 1,164, accession 0000796343-26-000003
